dct_title_s: State Property in Delaware River at Burlington
dct_description_sm: Map shows the state owned land and grants in Burlington along the Delaware River.
Map has plan showing fill on property of the state of NJ, natural high water line indicated. Riparian lands, Riparian grants, and other properties are also present."
